PeteTimesSix.CategorizedCleaning.Cleanin.label: clean rooms
PeteTimesSix.CategorizedCleaning.Cleanin.description: Rooms that must stay spotless. Kitchens, hospitals and laboratories by default. Cleaned by the "mop" work column, which also takes high-priority custom entries.

PeteTimesSix.CategorizedCleaning.Cleanin.label: interior
PeteTimesSix.CategorizedCleaning.Cleanin.description: Every other enclosed room inside the home area. Cleaned by the "sweep" work column, which also takes normal-priority custom entries.

PeteTimesSix.CategorizedCleaning.Cleanin.label: exterior
PeteTimesSix.CategorizedCleaning.Cleanin.description: The open home area, rooms the game counts as outdoors, and barns by default. Cleaned by the vanilla "clean" work column, which also takes low-priority custom entries. Out of the box it only cleans body fluids and debris, not the dirt that outdoor traffic makes endlessly.

PeteTimesSix.CategorizedCleaning.Cleanin.label: ignored
PeteTimesSix.CategorizedCleaning.Cleanin.description: Nobody cleans here. Move room types, rooms or zones into this lane to keep colonists out of them.

PeteTimesSix.CategorizedCleaning.Cleanin.label: custom
PeteTimesSix.CategorizedCleaning.Cleanin.description: Entries with their own rules: which filth kinds to clean, which work column does it (priority), and extra upkeep such as cutting plants, clearing snow or hauling debris. New cleaning zones start here.
